budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Meadow Woods trailer park, in receivership, will begin paying back taxes at $100,000 per year; close to $1 million is owed.
budget_items.quote: will begin paying back taxes at $100,000 per year until all back taxes are paid off. close to $1 million is owed.

budget_items.topic: Meadow Woods annual payment to free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The annual $100,000 Meadow Woods back-tax payment will go to free cash.
budget_items.quote: the annual $100,000 will go to free cash.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg's ARPA share is $3 million, under the lost revenue category; the Select Board will decide allocation.
budget_items.quote: lunenburg's $3 million share of arpa funds falls under the "lost revenue" category

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY2023 revenue estimates total $47,488,938, built 65% property tax, 22% State Aid, 6% local receipts, 7% available funds.
budget_items.quote: fy2023 revenue estimates come out to $47,488,938, built by 65 percent property tax, 22 percent state aid,

budget_items.topic: New Growth in the FY2023 target budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2023 Target Budget property tax revenue includes $213,523 for New Growth, plus a 2 ½ percent levy increase and debt exclusion amounts.
budget_items.quote: adding 2 ½ percent to the previous year's levy, $213,523 for new growth, and debt exclusion amounts.

budget_items.topic: FY2023 preliminary expenditures and debt service
budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY2023 preliminary budget expenditures total $43,202,314, and total appropriation for debt service is $4,497,723.
budget_items.quote: fy2023 preliminary budget expenditures total $43,202,314. total appropriation for debt service is $4,497,723.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2023 preliminary budget includes a $124,341 increase to health insurance.
The FY2023 preliminary budget reduces the Solid Waste Recycling Program by $42,000.

budget_items.topic: Free cash available for warrant articles
